question: Who among the following was the president of the Constituent Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __Dr Rajendra Prasad__.

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution of India was drafted by the Constituent Assembly.

 
 
• It was implemented under the Cabinet Mission Plan on 16 May 1946.
 
• The members of the Constituent Assembly were elected by the provincial assemblies by a single, transferable-vote system of proportional representation.
 
• Dr Rajendra Prasad was the president of the constituent assembly.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The members of the Constituent Assembly were elected by Provincial legislative councils.
 
• They elected people from the whole country to represent every area.
 
• It was elected in December and the first meeting in 1946.
 
• It came to force on 26th January 1950.
 
• Dr BR Ambedkar was the chairman of the Drafting Committee.
